news.title: India attracts students from 173 countries as overseas enrolment rises 19%
news.summary_en: Latest AISHE figures show India enrolled more than 58,000 international students in 2023/24, with Nepal remaining the largest source market and Karnataka emerging as the leading destination state.
news.author: Abhishek Nair

news.title: “The tsunami keeps coming”: US leaders react to final D/S rule
news.summary_en: Following the Department of Homeland Security (DHS) announcing the end of duration of status, leaders share their take on the Trump administration’s “arbitrary intrusion” into higher education.
news.author: Polly Nash

news.title: Canada fraud case exposes “acute” sector integrity issues
news.summary_en: Two people have been charged for an immigration scheme in Canada defrauding international students of CAD$126,000 – as the case raises longstanding concerns about unethical recruitment practices.
news.author: Polly Nash

news.title: Fulbright lives to see another day as elimination amendment deafeated
news.summary_en: US lawmakers have voted down a proposal to scrap the Fulbright program, with stakeholders hailing strong bipartisan backing for international exchange.
news.author: Beth Kennedy

news.title: US finalises rule ending duration of status
news.summary_en: In a move slammed as "harmful" and "shortsighted", the US government has finalised its rule replacing ‘duration of status’ with fixed time limits on student and exchange visas.
news.author: Polly Nash

news.title: Record UG international applicants to UK, UCAS data shows
news.summary_en: The number of international UCAS applicants to undergraduate programs in the UK has reached record highs, it has been revealed.
news.author: Beth Kennedy

news.title: Fraud increases 38% in UK university admissions
news.summary_en: Suspected fraud in UK university admissions has risen sharply since last year, as experts warn of “increasingly sophisticated” attempts to circumvent verification.
news.author: Polly Nash

news.title: Victoria launches refreshed strategy to strengthen international education
news.summary_en: The Victorian government has unveiled a refreshed strategy aimed at cementing the state's position as a leading destination for international students, backed by AUD $18.6 million over two years to improve the student experience and grow one of Victoria's biggest export industries.
news.author: Kim Martin

news.title: UK TNE’s next phase must be built with partners – not exported to them
news.summary_en: Here are the five questions institutions should be asking themselves when setting up new transnational education (TNE) ventures, writes Stephanie Pitticas.
news.author: Stephanie Pitticas

news.title: Germany says new dMAT will not be a “pass-fail barrier” for Indian students
news.summary_en: The German Embassy and DAAD say the Digital Master Test will become an additional component of APS documentation for selected Indian master's applicants, giving German universities a comparable academic reference point while helping applicants demonstrate their academic strengths.
news.author: Abhishek Nair

news.title: UK: Pakistani market shrinking ahead of September intake
news.summary_en: The number of Pakistani students accepting a place or being issued a CAS from a UK university has fallen sharply year on year, according to preliminary data from Enroly.
news.author: Beth Kennedy

news.title: Can benchmarking help US universities navigate internationalisation headwinds?
news.summary_en: A new US internationalisation study aims to equip institutions with benchmarking data to inform strategy and strengthen internal advocacy, amid mounting sector challenges.
news.author: Polly Nash

news.title: Southeast Asia in flux: UK told “era of the mega market is over”
news.summary_en: Southeast Asia remains a growth region for international student mobility, but UK universities were warned they can no longer rely on prestige or a handful of major source markets to sustain recruitment.
news.author: Kim Martin

news.title: India on the rise as a study destination for local students
news.summary_en: As the ‘big four’ study destinations continue to lose market share, new data reveals a surge in Indian students opting for in-country postgraduate education.
news.author: Polly Nash

news.title: Scottish minister urges UK government to “get behind” international higher education
news.summary_en: International collaboration has “never been more important” and the UK must “stand up for the benefits of higher education as a true UK asset”, Scotland’s tertiary education minister told the BUILA conference in Glasgow.
news.author: Kim Martin
